title: Ashoka: The King Who Gave Up War After Kalinga
description:
In 261 BCE, Ashoka won the bloody Kalinga war — and then wrote in stone that he was sorry. The real story of the Maurya emperor, separating inscriptions from legend.

14:00 The fall of the Mauryas
